checks.evidence: Owner performs two ordinary operations (whitelist a token, fund its pot). Harm is NON-OBVIOUS: the single qualifying cost (nudgeSize mints) is paid ONCE but _payRewards sweeps the FULL balance of EVERY whitelisted token, so the safe funding threshold silently migrates from per-token (pot_i < qualifying cost) to whitelist-AGGREGATE (SUM(pot_i) < qualifying cost). Contract's only stated bound is per-token. Dispositive: the PRIOR audit triage (858e9e80) itself reasoned per-token and missed the aggregation, so a competent non-malicious owner following the documented per-token model would be genuinely surprised. Law-3 SURPRISE test => footgun => IN SCOPE. Not malice, not obvious misconfig.

858e9e80 (per-token H-01 wont-fix) + 521c20ad (per-token M-01 wont-fix) rest on a single-token margin (6.7x) and worthless-NFT sunk-cost. Neither de-fangs the AGGREGATE: profit denominated in swept reward tokens, only ONE mint cost for N pots. Distinct story-025 whole-whitelist path; disclosed, per-token triageReason not overridden.
Concrete root cause _payRewards(recipient, snapshot) L434/L541; PoC-proven net +1051.27e18.
